body:
JsDelivr has changed the way the URL are formatted, to import directly the v2 in your page you need to use [the links here](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/guides/usage.html#directly-in-your-page).

If you have an already working instantsearch.js implementation, you probably need to change some elements in your code. You can follow [this guide](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/guides/migration.html) to migrate.
